coverage.landlord_size_condition: All landlords and foreclosing owners; no size threshold
coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords and foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston, with no unit-count or landlord-size threshold. The only exempt properties are residences in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, and in non-profit short-term substance-abuse treatment facilities.

result.notes: I removed the summary sentence about the state notice-to-quit form (G.L. c. 186, § 31) and the state notice periods (G.L. c. 186, §§ 11-12). None of the documents mentions those statutes. supersedes_state_rule was false; I set it to null because no document addresses how this rule relates to state law. The hospital, health-facility and substance-abuse facility exemptions are now listed in unverifiable_exemptions instead of other_conditions, because an address or assessor lookup cannot reliably check them. requires_unknown_facts stays false: the rule covers all ordinary rental units in Boston.
